t: Given a linear equation in two variables: 5x + 7y - 8 = 0, which of the following linear equations, along with the given equation, forms a system of linear equations having no solution?
e:
Two lines are parallel (and have no solution) if their coefficients of x and y are proportional but the constant terms differ. i.e their slopes must be equal and also should have different intercept
Slope of equation is:-
5x + 7y - 8 = 0
Slope = -5/7
So Let's check slope of each given equation:-
1) 5x + 7y - 16 = 0
Slope = -5/7 (same slope as the given equation and different intercept)
2) 7x + 5y - 8 = 0
Slope = -7/5 (different slope)
3) 5x - 7y - 8 = 0
Slope = 5/7 (different slope)
4) 10x + 14y - 16 = 0
Slope = -10/14 = -5/7 (same slope as the given equation, but same intercept)
Option (a) is the correct answer.

t: Anna and Ben each have a collection of marbles. If Anna gives one marble to Ben, they will both have an equal number of marbles. Conversely, if Ben gives one marble to Anna, she will end up with three times the number of marbles that Ben has. What is the total number of marbles they both have?
e:
Let Anna have A marbles and Ben have B marbles.
According to question,
A - 1 = B + 1.......(i)
A + 1 = 3(B - 1)........(ii)
From (i) :
A - 1 = B + 1
=> A = B + 2
From (ii) :
A + 1 = 3(B - 1)
Substitute A = B + 2 in the (ii):
(B + 2) + 1 = 3(B - 1)
=> B + 3 = 3B - 3
=> 6 = 2B
=> B = 3
Substitute B = 3 in A = B + 2:
A = 3 + 2
=> A = 5
Total number of marbles = A + B
Total number of marbles = 5 + 3
=> Total number of marbles = 8

And

Expression: -M + 3 + 5 + N = 0

When x = 1,
Expression: M + 3 - 5 + N = 0

h: नमन ने एक दुकान से 720 डॉलर में कुछ सेब खरीदे। उसने मोल-तोल करके कीमत तय की और दुकानदार ने प्रति सेब 2 डॉलर कम कर दिए। इस वजह से नमन पहले खरीदे गए सेब से चार ज़्यादा सेब खरीद सका। उसने शुरू में कितने सेब खरीदे थे?

t: The number of ₹10 coins is 3 times as many as the number of ₹5 coins, and the ratio of the number of ₹2 and ₹5 is 5:9 respectively. If the total number of coins lies between 300 and 350, then what is the total value of all the coins?
e:
Let the number of ₹5 coins = x
Number of ₹10 coins = 3x
Number of ₹2 coins => 5x/9
Total number of all the coins = x + 3x + 5x/9 = 41x/9
So, the total number of coins are multiple of 41.
Since, 300 < 41*8 < 350
So, total number of coins = 41*8
41x/9 = 41*8
x = 72
Total value of all the coins = 5*x + 10*3x + 2*5x/9
= (35 + 10/9)*72
= 8*325
= ₹2600
h: '10 के सिक्कों की संख्या '5 के सिक्कों की संख्या से तीन गुना है, तथा '2 और '5 की संख्या का अनुपात क्रमशः 5:9 है। यदि सिक्कों की कुल संख्या 300 और 350 के बीच है, तो सभी सिक्कों का कुल मूल्य क्या है?

t: If a and b are roots of quadratic equation x<sup>2</sup> - 22x + 85 = 0 and a > b, then how many numbers between 100 and 1500 are divisible by both (a - b) and average of a and b?
e:
x<sup>2</sup> - 22x + 85 = 0
x<sup>2</sup> - 17x - 5x + 85 = 0
x = 17, 5
a = 17, b = 5
a - b = 17 - 5 = 12
Average of a and b = (17 + 5)/2 = 11
Numbers divisible by both 12 and 11 = numbers divisible by LCM of 12 and 11
LCM of 12 and 11 = 132
Numbers between 100 and 1500 which are divisible by 132 = 132, 264,...., 1452.
Total numbers = ((1452 - 132)/1320 + 1 = 11
h: यदि a और b द्विघात समीकरण x<sup>2</sup> - 22x + 85 = 0 और a > b के मूल हैं, तो 100 और 1500 के बीच कितनी संख्याएँ (a - b) और a और b के औसत दोनों से विभाज्य हैं?

t: How many terms of the series -11, -8, -5, ......... must be taken so that the sum of all the terms is 9?
e:
Series given = -11, -8, -5, .........
Sum of the series = 9
Let n number of terms be taken.
By the formula of arithmetic progression,
9 = n/2 [2 * -11 + (n - 1) * 3]
9 = (n/2) [-22 + 3n - 3]
18 = 3n<sup>2</sup> - 25n
3n<sup>2</sup> - 25n - 18 = 0
3n<sup>2</sup> - 27n + 2n - 18 = 0
3n (n - 9) + 2 (n - 9) = 0
(n - 9) (3n + 2) = 0
n = 9 or -2/3 [n cannot be negative]
So, n = 9

t: What number should be subtracted from x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11 to make the number divisible by (x + 2)?
e:
If an equation is divisible by (x+2), so it means (x+2) is a factor of that equation.
So, x+2=0, x=-2
Now putting the value of x=-2 in the equation x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11, we get:
(-2)<sup>3</sup> - 4(-2)<sup>2</sup> - 8(-2) +11
=-8-16+16+11
=3
So if 3 is subtracted from x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11 , it will be completely divisible by (x+2)
Option (c) is the correct answer.
h: x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11 में से कौन सी संख्या घटाई जानी चाहिए ताकि संख्या (x + 2) से विभाज्य हो जाए?

t: In a playground, every two children play chess between them, every four children play carrom among them, and every five children play basketball among them. If the total number of chess boards, carrom boards, and basketballs together is 114 and all children play each game, then find the total number of children.
e:
Let the total number of children be 'X'.
Therefore,
The total number of children who play chess = X/2
The total number of children who play carrom = X/4
The total number of children who play basketball = X/5
A/Q
X/2 + X/4 + X/5 = 114
(10X + 5X + 4X)/20 = 114
19X/20 = 114
X = 114 * 20/19
X = 120
Hence, the total number of children is 120.
h: एक खेल के मैदान में, हर दो बच्चे आपस में शतरंज खेलते हैं, हर चार बच्चे आपस में कैरम खेलते हैं, और हर पाँच बच्चे आपस में बास्केटबॉल खेलते हैं। यदि शतरंज बोर्ड, कैरम बोर्ड और बास्केटबॉल की कुल संख्या 114 है और सभी बच्चे प्रत्येक खेल खेलते हैं, तो बच्चों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Cost of drink A per litre is 3/5 of the cost of drink B per litre. A man wanted to buy certain quantity of drink A and 8 litres of drink B. But by mistake, the quantity of drink A and drink B got exchanged so the man is ended up paying 40% more. How much quantity of drink A did he wants to buy?
e:
Cost of drink B per litre = ₹5a
Cost of drink A per litre = ₹3a
Let the quantity of drink A bought by man = 'b' litres
Original cost = b*3a + 8*5a = a(3b + 40)
Cost after exchange = 8*3a + b*5a = a(24 + 5b)
Now,
a(24 + 5b) = 140% of a(3b + 40)
5(24 + 5b) = 7(3b + 40)
4b = 160
b = 40
So, the quantity of drink A he wants to buy = 40 litres
h: पेय A की प्रति लीटर कीमत, पेय B की प्रति लीटर कीमत का 3/5 है। एक व्यक्ति पेय A की एक निश्चित मात्रा और पेय B के 8 लीटर खरीदना चाहता था। लेकिन गलती से पेय A और पेय B की मात्रा आपस में बदल गई, इसलिए व्यक्ति को 40% अधिक भुगतान करना पड़ा। वह पेय A की कितनी मात्रा खरीदना चाहता था?

t: If α + β + γ = 0, then (5β<sup>2</sup> + 2α<sup>2</sup> + γ<sup>2</sup>)/( 6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ) = ?

t: The ratio of VIP and Regular concert ticket prices for a music festival is 7:4, and the ratio of the number of VIP to Regular ticket holders is 2:5. If the total revenue collected from ticket sales on a particular day was ₹51000, find the amount collected from Regular ticket holders.

34XY = 51000

t: There are two numbers X and Y such that geometric mean of X and Y is four-fifth of the Arithmetic mean of X and Y. What is the ratio of X and Y?
e:
The geometric mean of X and Y is four-fifth of the Arithmetic mean of X and Y
=> √XY = (4/5) * (X + Y)/2
=> (X + Y)/2√XY = 5/4
By componendo and dividendo rule,
(X + Y + 2√XY)/(X + Y - 2√XY) = (5+4)/(5-4)
=> (√X + √Y)<sup>2</sup>/(√X - √Y)<sup>2</sup> = 9/1
=> (√X + √Y)/(√X - √Y) = 3
=> √X + √Y = 3√X - 3√Y
=> 2√X = 4√Y
=> √X/√Y = 2
=> X/Y = 4/1

t: In a garden, there are 6 daisy plants the first year. Each year, a gardener adds 3 new daisy plants. He has 26 jasmine plants the first year and loses 2 each year. When will the number of daisy plants equal to the number of jasmine plants after the first year?
e:
Let the number of years after the first year be n .
Number of daisy plants after n years = 6 + 3n
Number of jasmine plants after n years = 26 - 2n
We need to find when the number of daisy plants equals the number of jasmine plants:
6 + 3n = 26 - 2n
=> 6 + 3n = 26 - 2n
=> 3n + 2n = 26 - 6
=> 5n = 20
=> n = 4

t: The age of Atul, Vibha and Karan are in AP respectively. After two years, the age of Atul is one-third of the age of Karan and present age of Vibha is 3 years less than thrice of the present age of Atul. Find the sum of their current ages.
e:
Let the age of Atul, Vibha and Karan are (a - d), a and (a + d) respectively.
Now,
(a - d) + 2 = 1/3 * (a + d + 2)
a = 2d - 2 -----(1)
and
a = 3 * (a - d) - 3
2a = 3d + 3 -----(2)
From eqn (1) and (2) -
4d - 4 = 3d + 3
d = 7, a = 12
Sum of their current ages = a - d + a + a + d = 3*12 = 36 years

t: At a charity event, Rina donates Rs.264 using a total of 50 coins consisting of Rs.2, Rs.5, and Rs.10 denominations. If the number of Rs.2 coins to Rs.5 coins is in the ratio 3: 7, how many Rs.10 coins did she donate?
e:
Let the number of Rs.2 coins and Rs.5 coins be 3x and 7x respectively.
Then,
Number of Rs.10 coins used = 50 - 10x
Total amount donated = 264
10 * (50 - 10x) + 2 * 3x + 5 * 7x = 264
500 - 100x + 6x + 35x = 264
500 - 59x = 264
59x = 236
x = 4
Number of Rs.10 coins she donated = 50 - 10 * 4 = 10
h: एक चैरिटी कार्यक्रम में, रीना ने 2 रुपये, 5 रुपये और 10 रुपये के कुल 50 सिक्कों का उपयोग करके 264 रुपये दान किए। यदि 2 रुपये और 5 रुपये के सिक्कों की संख्या का अनुपात 3: 7 है, तो उसने कितने 10 रुपये के सिक्के दान किए?

So :

4k+16≠ 36
4k≠20

t: An exam has 60 questions, each question carries +4 marks and a penalty of −1 marks while there is no penalty for not attempting a question. Wasim and Shoaib attempted all the questions and got 130 and 145 marks respectively. Find the total number of questions they answered correctly.
e:
They both attempted all the questions
Total marks = 60 * 4 = 240
Each incorrect question will cause a decrease of 5 marks
Total decrease = (240 - 130 + 240 - 145) = 205
Total number of incorrect questions = 205/5 = 41
Total number of questions they answered correctly = 2 * 60 - 41 = 79
h: एक परीक्षा में 60 प्रश्न हैं, प्रत्येक प्रश्न के लिए +4 अंक हैं और ₹1 का दंड है जबकि किसी प्रश्न का उत्तर न देने पर कोई दंड नहीं है। वसीम और शोएब ने सभी प्रश्नों का उत्तर दिया और उन्हें क्रमशः 130 और 145 अंक मिले। उनके द्वारा सही उत्तर दिए गए कुल प्रश्नों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: There are 160 multiple choice questions in a test. 4 marks are allotted for a correct answer and 1 mark is deducted for a wrong answer or un-attempted question from the total score of correct answers. If a candidate scored 400 marks in the test, how many questions did he answer correctly?
e: Let c = correct answers, w = wrong or unattempted. Total questions: c + w = 160. Score: 4c - w = 400. Solve: c + w = 160 w = 160 - c. Substitute: 4c - (160 - c) = 400 4c - 160 + c = 400 5c - 160 = 400 5c = 560 c = 560 / 5 = 112. w = 160 - 112 = 48. Option (c) is the correct answer.
h: एक टेस्ट में 160 बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न हैं। एक सही उत्तर के लिए 4 अंक आवंटित किए जाते हैं और एक गलत उत्तर या बिना प्रयास किए गए प्रश्न के लिए सही उत्तरों के कुल स्कोर से 1 अंक काटा जाता है। यदि किसी उम्मीदवार ने टेस्ट में 400 अंक प्राप्त किए, तो उसने कितने प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर दिए?

t: Third and sixth term of a Geometric Progression are 16 and 432 respectively. Calculate the sum of its first term and common ratio.
e: For the given Geometric Progression: Let first term = a And, common ratio = r Third term in geometric progression = ar2 = 16 a = 16/r2 Sixth term in geometric progression = ar5 = 432 Then, (16/r2) x r5 = 432 r = 3 Now, a = 16/(3 * 3) = 16/9 Therefore, a + r = (16/9) + 3 = 43/9

t: When the numerator of a fraction is increased by 50% and the denominator is increased by 25%, the resulting fraction becomes 3/4. Find the reciprocal of the original fraction.
e: Let the original fraction be p/q When the numerator of the fraction p increases by 50%, it becomes 3p/2 When the denominator of the fraction q increases by 25%, it becomes 5q/4 According to the question, = => p/q = 5/8 Hence, the reciprocal of the original fraction = = 8/5
h: जब किसी भिन्न के अंश में 50% की वृद्धि की जाती है और हर में 25% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो परिणामी भिन्न 3/4 हो जाती है। मूल भिन्न का व्युत्क्रम ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Each of Ravi and Kavita had some marbles. Kavita had 12 more marbles than Ravi had. If each of them had one more marble, then three times the number of marbles Kavita would then have had would have been equal to four times the number of marbles Ravi would then have had. How many marbles did Kavita actually have?
e:
Let number of marbles Ravi had= x .
So kavita had=x+12
If each of them had one more marble then,
kavita had=x+12+1=x+13
similarly Ravi=x+1
and,
3(x + 13) = 4(x + 1)
3x + 39 = 4x + 4
39 - 4 = 4x - 3x
So x =35
So,Ravi=35 and kavita = 35+12=47
option (b) is the correct answer.
h: रवि और कविता दोनों के पास कुछ मार्बल थे। कविता के पास रवि से 12 मार्बल ज़्यादा थे। अगर उनमें से हर एक के पास एक मार्बल ज़्यादा होता, तो कविता के पास जितने मार्बल होते, उनकी संख्या का तीन गुना रवि के पास जितने मार्बल होते, उनकी संख्या का चार गुना होता। कविता के पास वास्तव में कितने मार्बल थे?

t: A school sports teacher purchases 7 badminton rackets and 6 shuttlecocks for ₹7600. Later, she buys 3 badminton rackets and 5 shuttlecocks for ₹3500. Find the cost of each racket and each shuttlecock respectively.
e:
Let price of each racket and each shuttlecock be Rs. A, and Rs. B respectively.
Given that,
7A + 6B = 7600 ... (1)
3A + 5B = 3500 ... (2)
After solving equation (1) and (2).
B = 100 and A = 1000
Therefore,
Cost of each racket = Rs.1000
And cost of each shuttlecock = Rs.100
h: एक स्कूल स्पोर्ट्स टीचर ने 7 बैडमिंटन रैकेट और 6 शटलकॉक 7600 डॉलर में खरीदे। बाद में, उसने 3 बैडमिंटन रैकेट और 5 शटलकॉक 3500 डॉलर में खरीदे। प्रत्येक रैकेट और प्रत्येक शटलकॉक की कीमत क्रमशः ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The cost of 4 desks and 2 stools together is ₹3200, while the cost of 2 desks and 5 stools together is ₹2800. Find the total cost of 1 desk and 4 stools.
e:
Let the cost of 1 desk and 1 stool be Rs. A, and Rs. B respectively.
Given that
4A + 2B = 3200
2A + B = 1600 ... (1)
And
2A + 5B = 2800 ... (2)
After solving equations (1) and (2),
B = 300 and A = 650
Total cost of 1 desk and 4 stools = 650 + 4 * 300 = 650 + 1200 = Rs.1850
h: चार डेस्क और दो स्टूल की कुल कीमत ₹3200 है, जबकि दो डेस्क और पांच स्टूल की कुल कीमत ₹2800 है। एक डेस्क और चार स्टूल की कुल कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A and B each have a certain number of oranges. A says to B, "If you give me 10 of your oranges, I will have twice the number of oranges left with you." B replies, "If you give me 10 of your oranges, I will have the same number of oranges left with you." How many oranges does A have?
e:
Let number of oranges A and B have 'a' and 'b' respectively.
By A's statement:
a + 10 = 2(b - 10)
a - 2b = -30 ---(1)
By B's statement:
b + 10 = a - 10
a - b = 20 ----(2)
Eqn(1) - 2*eqn(2):
(a - 2b) - 2(a - b) = -30 - 2*20
a = 70
Hence, number of oranges A have = 70
h: A और B में से प्रत्येक के पास निश्चित संख्या में संतरे हैं। A, B से कहता है, "यदि तुम मुझे अपने 10 संतरे दे दोगे, तो मेरे पास तुम्हारे पास बचे संतरे की संख्या से दुगुने संतरे बचेंगे।" B उत्तर देता है, "यदि तुम मुझे अपने 10 संतरे दे दोगे, तो मेरे पास तुम्हारे पास बचे संतरे की संख्या के बराबर संतरे बचेंगे।" A के पास कितने संतरे हैं?

t: At a certain time in a park, the number of legs of parrots and frogs were counted and it was found that there were 43 heads and 136 legs. Find the difference between the number of parrots and frogs in the park.
e:

Total number of heads = 43
X + Y = 43 -----(1)
Total number of legs = 136
2X + 4Y = 136 -----(2)
From eqn (1) and (2) -
X = 18, Y = 25
Required difference = 25 - 18 = 7

t: There are 90 students in a hostel. Due to new admissions, 30 new students join the mess, and the daily expenses of the mess increases by ₹560, while the average expenditure per head diminishes by ₹10. What was the original daily expenditure (in ₹) of the mess?
e:
Let average expenditure per day = Rs. x
So, total expenditure = Rs. 90x
After admission of 30 more students,
Total Expense = 90x + 560
Average Expense = x - 10
According to the question,
120(x - 10) = 90x + 560
30x = 1760
90x = 5280
Original Expenditure = Rs. 5280

Sum of cubes of the numbers from (11 to 20)
= (Sum of cubes of numbers from 1 to 20) - (Sum of cubes of the numbers from 1 to 10)
= ((20 x21)/2)<sup>2</sup> - ((10 x11)/2)<sup>2</sup>
= (210)<sup>2</sup> - (55)<sup>2</sup>
= 44100 - 3025 = 41075

t: P got married 15 years ago. Today her age is 1(3/5) times her age at the time of her marriage. At present her son's age is 1/5 of her age. What was her son's age 4 years ago as a fraction of P's age at that time?
e:
P's current age = p
Age at marriage = p - 15
p = (8/5) X (p - 15)
p = (8/5)p - 24
(3/5)p = 24
p = 40 years
Son's current age = (1/5) X 40 = 8 years
4 years ago: Son = 8 - 4 = 4, P = 40 - 4 = 36
Fraction = 4 / 36 = 1/9
Option 1 is the correct answer
h: P की शादी 15 साल पहले हुई थी। आज उसकी उम्र उसकी शादी के समय की उम्र से 1(3/5) गुना है। वर्तमान में उसके बेटे की उम्र उसकी उम्र की 1/5 है। 4 साल पहले उसके बेटे की उम्र P की उस समय की उम्र के अंश के रूप में क्या थी?

t: Find the remainder when 7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20 is divided by x + 3.
e:
By remainder theorem:
x + 3 = 0
x = -3
By putting the value of x in 7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20, we can find the remainder.
7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20
= 7 * (-3)<sup>5</sup> + 15 * (-3)<sup>4</sup> - 6 * (-3)<sup>3</sup> + (-3) + 20
= 81(-21 + 15) + 162 - 3 + 20
= - 486 + 179
= - 307
h: 7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20 को x + 3 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A zookeeper counted a total of 80 heads in an enclosure. Upon checking, he found that there were 220 legs. If the only animals present were kangaroos and parrots, where each kangaroo had four legs and each parrot had two, how many kangaroos were in the enclosure?
e:
Number of heads = number of kangaroos + number of parrots
Let number of parrots be X.
Then number of kangaroos be (80 - X).
Total number of legs = 220
2X + 4(80 - X) = 220
2X + 320 - 4X = 220
2X = 100
X = 50
Number of kangaroos = 80 - 50 = 30
h: एक चिड़ियाघर के रखवाले ने एक बाड़े में कुल 80 सिर गिने। जाँच करने पर उसने पाया कि वहाँ 220 पैर थे। यदि वहाँ केवल कंगारू और तोते ही मौजूद थे, जहाँ प्रत्येक कंगारू के चार पैर थे और प्रत्येक तोते के दो पैर थे, तो बाड़े में कितने कंगारू थे?

t: What is the value of [(a<sup>2</sup> - 12bc - 4c<sup>2</sup> - 9b<sup>2</sup>)/(a<sup>2</sup> - 4c<sup>2</sup> + 6ab + 9b<sup>2</sup>)]?

t: The present age of Tanya is 3/8 times of Meenu's age. Four years ago, Tanya's age was 2/7 times Meenu's age at that time. What was the age of Jiya six years ago if Jiya is four years younger than Meenu?
e:
Let present age of Tanya = 3x years and present age of Meenu = 8x years
Four years ago, Tanya's age was 2/7 times Meenu's age at that time.
=> (3x - 4)/ (8x - 4) = 2/7
=> x = 4
So, the age of Jiya 6 years ago = 8 * 4 - 4 - 6 = 22 years

t: The 10<sup>th</sup> term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7<sup>th</sup> term of the series. If 5<sup>th</sup> term of the series is 80, then what is the 8<sup>th</sup> term of the series?

=> ar<sup>9</sup> = 8 * ar<sup>6</sup>
=> r<sup>3</sup> = 8
=> r = 2
5<sup>th</sup> term of the series is 80.
=> ar<sup>4</sup> = 80
=> a * 2<sup>4</sup> = 80
=> a = 80/16
=> a = 5

= 81 - 128
= − 47

= − 47/4096
